map.赠与税与遗产税的关系？: How is gift tax related to estate tax?
map.两者常配套设计以防避税，赠与税针对生前的财产转移，遗产税针对身后的 inheri: The two are often paired to prevent avoidance; gift tax targets lifetime transfers, estate tax targets post-death inheritance.
map.免税额是每次还是累计？: Is the exemption per gift or cumulative?
map.取决于税制，有的按每次赠与、有的按纳税人终身累计，应以当地规则为准。: Depends on the system: per-gift or lifetime cumulative per taxpayer; follow local rules.
map.赠与税：T = max(赠与额 − 免税额, 0) × 税率；联动量：应税金额: Gift tax: T = max(gift amount − exemption, 0) × rate; linked values: taxable amount = max(gift amount − exemption, 0) (CNY), effective rate = T ÷ gift amount × 100 (%, denominator falls back to 1 when gift amount is 0 to avoid division by zero). Validation: no strict validation, empty values fall back to 0. Rule: no fixed grading; when the exemption is not below the gift amount the tax is 0.
